organization.name_en: Ride On Express Holdings Co., Ltd.

affected.note: Maximum number of records registered on the official sites and apps of Gin no Sara, Kamatora and Sushi Jyoto that may have leaked; the company says this is not a confirmed leak count. Family members' and delivery recipients' details entered by users may also be affected. Card data is not held. The company did not name the server operator.

summary.en: Ride On Express Holdings said the operator of servers storing registration data for its Gin no Sara, Kamatora and Sushi Jyoto delivery sites and apps was hit by a ransomware attack on 2026-10-07. Up to about 6.5 million records, including names, addresses, phone numbers, birthdates and password hashes, may have leaked.
summary.ja: ライドオンエクスプレスホールディングスは、「銀のさら」「釜寅」「すし上等」の公式サイト・アプリの登録者情報を保管していたサーバーの運営会社が2026年10月7日にランサムウェア攻撃を受けたと発表した。氏名、住所、電話番号、生年月日、パスワードのハッシュ値などを含む最大約650万件が漏えいした可能性がある。
